title: Runtime Architecture: Hosted Device Pairing Handshake

components.name: Signed-in operator
components.responsibility: Initiate Cloud /connect or /restore, paste or confirm the pairing code locally, and use Bot /app only after a live daemon-minted session_token handoff.
components.process_boundary: Human interaction with Cloud bootstrap pages, local CLI approve, and the Bot /app shell.
components.authority_role: Sole authority for the local approve or deny decision; not an authority that mints session_token or enrollment grants.
components.multiplicity: One human operator per pairing ceremony.
prohibited_authority: Treat possession of the pairing code as approval
Approve through Cloud or the SPA
Treat Cloud HostedSession or DaemonPairing as /app success
Mint or forge session_token or enrollment authorization

components.name: Cloud /connect and /restore HTML
components.responsibility: Serve the sole production fresh-pair bootstrap at /connect and the quiet cross-visit /restore surface; browser JS requests and polls the local daemon but never approves.
components.process_boundary: Cloud-hosted HTML and inline JS for /connect and /restore only.
components.authority_role: Coordinator and UI host for request/poll/restore; not pairing approval authority and not session_token mint authority.
inputs: resolved sole Alpha domain team_id (Cloud-issued opaque ID; idempotent auto-create if zero + TEAM_CREATED; distinct 409 repair path if >1)
transient cloud_access_token from the signed-in Cloud session (pending-record custody only)
outputs: redirect to Bot /app or back to /connect
POST /pair payload including team_id and cloud_access_token
SPA mapping of MissingTeamId / MissingCloudAccessToken 400 to return-to-/connect
components.multiplicity: One Cloud bootstrap surface family per hosted origin.
prohibited_authority: Call POST /pair/decision
Return or invent session_token before daemon approve
Treat DaemonPairing or HostedSession as bridge approval
Write session_token to durable browser storage
Couple pairing to Google OAuth or Drive tokens

components.name: Bot /app after handoff
components.responsibility: Run the post-pair product shell only when a live daemon-minted session_token is present; otherwise leave to /restore or /connect.
components.process_boundary: Bot dashboard SPA after Cloud handoff.
components.authority_role: Consumer of live session_token for hosted-bridge reads; never the mint or approve authority.
components.multiplicity: Zero or more browser tabs; none is paired without a live token.
prohibited_authority: Re-host the /connect pairing wizard
Treat Cloud HostedSession or DaemonPairing alone as paired-enough for /app
Approve pairing decisions
Persist session_token in localStorage

components.name: Local daemon hosted-bridge gateway
components.responsibility: Accept pending-first pair requests, enforce LOCAL-only decisions, mint opaque pairing_id plus ephemeral session_token and enrollment authorization at approve, and re-mint session_token from durable pairing_id after restart without a new code.
components.authority_role: Sole authority for pair approve/deny, pairing_id issuance, session_token mint/remint, and enrollment-authorization mint.
inputs: pair request with origin, cloud_account_id, non-empty team_id, and cloud_access_token
local approve or deny with nonce
pair status poll with request_handle and poll_proof
outputs: 400 with typed kind MissingTeamId or MissingCloudAccessToken when team_id or cloud_access_token is missing or empty on POST /pair
typed deny expire revoke or update_required outcomes
components.multiplicity: One active daemon instance identity per operator product home.
prohibited_authority: Accept remote Origin for /pair/decision
Return session_token on pending POST /pair
Accept pending POST /pair without non-empty team_id
Accept pending POST /pair without non-empty cloud_access_token
Persist, log, or return cloud_access_token outside pending-record custody
Treat Cloud HostedSession as enrollment grant
Require a new pairing code after daemon restart when durable pairing_id remains valid
Adopt Dogwood TRACE or UOR as Alpha runtime dependency for this hop

components.name: Durable local pairing_id relationship store
components.responsibility: Persist the opaque pairing_id relationship bound to cloud_account_id, approved origin, protocol/profile version, and daemon instance identity across daemon process death.
components.process_boundary: Operator-local durable store owned by the daemon (new relative to today's in-memory sessions).
components.repository_runtime: BicameralAI/bicameral-bot local daemon persistence (not yet shipped as durable pairing_id store).
components.authority_role: Persistence owner for pairing_id relationships; writers remain the daemon gateway.
components.multiplicity: One relationship record per opaque pairing_id.
prohibited_authority: Mint session_token without daemon gateway policy
Share storage with Google OAuth or Drive token material
Treat restore proof alone as durable pairing_id

components.name: Ephemeral hosted-bridge session and pending memory
components.responsibility: Hold short-TTL pending pair requests and live HostedBridgePairingSession / session_token material in process memory (and browser sessionStorage for the handoff copy).
components.process_boundary: Daemon process memory for pending and live sessions; browser sessionStorage for the token handoff only.
components.repository_runtime: BicameralAI/bicameral-bot gateway state plus Cloud/Bot browser sessionStorage.
components.deployment_location: Daemon process and operator browser tab.
components.authority_role: Ephemeral persistence only; not the durable pairing relationship authority.
outputs: live session_token until expiry revoke or process death
components.multiplicity: One pending or live session record per request_handle / session while alive.
prohibited_authority: Survive daemon restart as the pairing relationship
Act as enrollment authorization
Be written to durable browser localStorage as authority

components.name: bicameral pairing approve CLI
components.responsibility: List or look up local pending pairing requests and submit LOCAL-only approve or deny decisions with the confirmation nonce.
components.process_boundary: Foreground local Bot CLI pairing commands.
components.authority_role: Local decision transport for the operator; daemon remains commit authority.
components.multiplicity: One CLI decision transaction per pending request.
prohibited_authority: Approve from a remote Cloud caller
Return session_token in the decision response
Bypass nonce or loopback Origin checks

components.name: Daemon-served local approval page
components.responsibility: Render a pending pairing request (requesting origin, Cloud account, capability summary, expiry) on loopback and submit the operator's explicit approve or deny through the same LOCAL-only decision endpoint the CLI uses.
components.process_boundary: Static page and script served by the local daemon at /local/pairing on the loopback gateway; no CORS, framing denied.
components.authority_role: Local decision transport for the operator; daemon remains commit authority. Cloud may open the page via local_confirmation_url but cannot read, frame, or submit it.
inputs: request_handle (from local_confirmation_url or local pending list)
outputs: LOCAL POST /pair/decision from loopback Origin with confirmation nonce
components.multiplicity: One decision transaction per pending request; terminal requests render read-only.
prohibited_authority: Approve from a remote Cloud caller
Approve without an explicit operator click on the loopback page
Return session_token in the decision response
Bypass nonce or loopback Origin checks
Serve under a non-loopback Host header or with CORS headers

components.name: Cloud enrollment consumer
components.responsibility: Consume the distinct enrollment authorization minted at local approve; adjacent row-12 verify/persist owner that must never treat HostedSession or DaemonPairing as the enrollment grant.
components.process_boundary: Cloud enrollment verify and trusted-key persistence (out of mint scope for this contract).
components.authority_role: Consumer of one-shot enrollment authorization; not mint authority and not /app pairing witness authority.
components.multiplicity: One consume attempt per enrollment authorization.
prohibited_authority: Treat HostedSession or DaemonPairing as enrollment grant
Mint pairing_id or session_token
Extend enrollment authorization TTL by Cloud policy alone
Reuse a consumed enrollment authorization

relationships.interaction: Opens Cloud /connect for a fresh pair or /restore when a bounded restore proof may still be valid.
relationships.medium: HTTPS browser navigation on the hosted Cloud origin.
relationships.handoff: Signed-in operator context enters the bootstrap or restore surface.
authority_boundaries: Opening /connect is not approval.
/restore must not present a second pairing wizard.

relationships.interaction: Browser JS POSTs pending-first /api/v1/hosted-bridge/pair with origin, cloud_account_id, CSRF, client_protocol_version, non-empty team_id, and cloud_access_token.
relationships.medium: Loopback HTTPS/HTTP to the local daemon with browser Origin.
relationships.handoff: 202 pending record with request_handle, poll_proof, pairing_code, and expiry — never session_token. Missing/empty team_id or cloud_access_token yields HTTP 400 with typed kind MissingTeamId or MissingCloudAccessToken.
authority_boundaries: Protocol floor is 4.
Immediate-token legacy responses are rejected by the Cloud bootstrap.
Cloud cannot approve on this relationship.
Alpha: exactly one domain-scoped team (idempotent auto-create if zero + TEAM_CREATED; distinct 409 with operator repair path if >1); Product selection is out of this hop.
Verified domain is Supabase-verified plus design-partner allowlist; consumer/shared domains are never allowlisted; team_id is a Cloud-issued opaque ID.
Client-supplied team_id is not enrollment trust alone; Cloud must verify bearer identity, allowlist, domain eligibility, and team_id/cloud_account_id binding at pairing create and enrollment.
Allowlisted-domain eligibility authorizes create/enroll of the caller's own pairing; team_owner is not required.

relationships.interaction: Operator pastes the pairing code and confirms approve or deny in the local CLI.
relationships.handoff: Explicit local human decision bound to the displayed pending request.
authority_boundaries: Code possession is not approval.
Only the local operator may authorize the CLI decision.

relationships.interaction: CLI submits LOCAL-only POST /pair/decision with approve|deny and confirmation nonce.
relationships.medium: Loopback HTTP to the daemon with missing/empty/loopback Origin only.
relationships.handoff: Daemon commits LOCAL_APPROVED or terminal deny; decision response never returns session_token.
authority_boundaries: Remote Origin callers are rejected.
One ceremony mints session_token and enrollment authorization as distinct artifacts.
Alpha TOFU binds daemon instance identity at first approve.

relationships.interaction: Operator opens the daemon-served page (from Cloud's Open local approval action or directly), reviews the request, and clicks Approve or Deny; the page submits LOCAL-only POST /pair/decision with the confirmation nonce.
relationships.medium: Same-origin loopback HTTP from http://127.0.0.1|localhost:<gateway port>.
relationships.handoff: Daemon commits LOCAL_APPROVED or terminal deny exactly as for the CLI; decision response never returns session_token; the initiating browser learns the outcome only through its own /pair/status poll.
authority_boundaries: Opening the page is not approval.
Only an explicit local operator click submits a decision.
Cloud cannot read the nonce (no CORS) or frame the page (frame-ancestors 'none').

relationships.interaction: Browser polls GET /pair/status with request_handle, poll_proof, and cloud_account_id until approved or terminal.
relationships.medium: Loopback HTTP status poll from Cloud bootstrap JS.
relationships.handoff: On approved + live session, transient session_token (+ expires_at) is released to the browser; pending/denied/expired yield no token.
authority_boundaries: Token is released only after local approve and only via status.
Retry-safe polls must not re-mint a new token while the session is live.

relationships.interaction: After approved status, Cloud writes session_token into sessionStorage and navigates to Bot /app.
relationships.medium: Browser sessionStorage handoff plus same-browser navigation.
relationships.handoff: Ephemeral session_token available to /app for live bridge use.
authority_boundaries: session_token must not be written to localStorage.
/app success witness is the live daemon token only.

relationships.interaction: Paired SPA calls hosted-bridge data-plane routes authorized by the live session_token.
relationships.medium: Loopback hosted-bridge HTTP with session token and Origin allowlist.
relationships.handoff: Authorized local projections and governed requests subject to daemon policy.
authority_boundaries: Missing expired or revoked token forces leave to /restore or /connect.
Bridge pairing is not Product membership or workspace binding.

relationships.interaction: At LOCAL_APPROVED, persist opaque pairing_id and bound metadata; on restart, look up the relationship to remint session_token without a new code.
relationships.handoff: Durable pairing relationship available across daemon process death until revoke or binding mismatch.
authority_boundaries: pairing_id is daemon-issued opaque Model B, not content-derived.
Store must not hold Google OAuth or Drive tokens.

relationships.interaction: Create pending records and live HostedBridgePairingSession material; release token copies only through status after approve.
relationships.medium: In-process daemon memory and browser sessionStorage handoff.
relationships.handoff: Ephemeral pending and session artifacts with short process lifetime.
authority_boundaries: Process memory is not the durable pairing_id relationship.
Decision responses must not include session_token.

relationships.interaction: Same local approve mints a distinct short-TTL one-shot enrollment authorization bound to pairing_id and daemon instance identity for Cloud consume.
relationships.medium: Enrollment authorization artifact handoff (PairingAuthorizationV1 local semantics; TRACE reference only).
relationships.handoff: Unconsumed enrollment authorization available to the row-12 Cloud consumer.
authority_boundaries: HostedSession and DaemonPairing are not enrollment grants.
Enrollment verify/persistence remains row 12 consumer scope.
Dogwood-backed reducer is parked for Alpha.

relationships.interaction: Cloud /restore revalidates Cloud auth and presents the bounded restore proof to retry-safe pair status for token re-release while the daemon session or durable relationship still authorizes it.
relationships.medium: HTTPS Cloud page plus loopback status exchange.
relationships.handoff: Re-released ephemeral session_token or fail-closed return to /connect.
authority_boundaries: Restore proof is a continuity witness, not approval authority.
Account mismatch expiry or revocation fails closed to /connect.
/restore is not Drive OAuth and not enrollment consume.

states.artifact: Pending hosted-bridge pair request (request_handle, poll_proof, pairing_code, team_id, short-TTL cloud_access_token custody, short TTL)
states.persistence_location: Daemon process memory; pending TTL on the order of minutes.
states.mutation_path: POST /pair creates pending only when team_id and cloud_access_token are non-empty; LOCAL /pair/decision or expiry/deny terminates it; cloud_access_token is pending-record custody only and is cleared on approve/deny/expiry; it is never persisted, logged, or returned.
states.lifecycle: Created pending-first without session_token; ends at approve, deny, or expiry.
prohibited_fallbacks: Return session_token while pending
Treat pending as durable pairing_id
Allow Cloud to approve the pending request
Accept pending without non-empty team_id
Accept pending without non-empty cloud_access_token
Persist, log, or return cloud_access_token

states.artifact: Durable opaque pairing_id relationship bound at LOCAL_APPROVED
states.persistence_location: Operator-local durable pairing store (required by this freeze; missing in today's in-memory Alpha).
states.mutation_path: Minted at local approve with cloud_account_id + approved origin + protocol/profile version + daemon instance identity; revoked or invalidated on binding mismatch.
states.lifecycle: Survives daemon restart until revoke, expiry policy, or account/origin/daemon identity mismatch.
prohibited_fallbacks: Derive pairing_id from content/UOR for Alpha
Lose relationship on daemon restart and force a new code when still valid
Share the store with OAuth/Drive tokens

states.persistence_location: Daemon process memory plus browser sessionStorage handoff only.
states.mutation_path: Minted or reminted by daemon after approve or durable reattach; released only via /pair/status; expires or revokes with the live session.
states.lifecycle: Ephemeral; required live witness for /app; may be reminted from durable pairing_id after daemon restart without a new code.
prohibited_fallbacks: Treat Cloud HostedSession or DaemonPairing as this token
Persist in localStorage as authority
Return on pending POST /pair or in /pair/decision response

states.artifact: Unconsumed enrollment authorization minted at local approve
states.persistence_location: Daemon-minted short-TTL grant artifact (PairingAuthorizationV1 local semantics).
states.routing_key: enrollment authorization id bound to pairing_id + daemon instance identity
states.mutation_path: Minted in the same approve ceremony as session_token; one-shot consume by Cloud enrollment consumer; expires on short TTL.
states.lifecycle: Unconsumed until one-shot Cloud consume, TTL expiry, or revoke of the parent relationship.
prohibited_fallbacks: Reuse HostedSession as the enrollment grant
Unlimited TTL or multi-consume
Require Dogwood reducer for Alpha mint

states.artifact: Cloud-trusted enrolled proof-signing key after enrollment authorization consume
states.persistence_location: Cloud enrollment trust material (row 12 consumer; adjacent witness for this mint-side contract).
states.routing_key: enrolled key identity bound to pairing_id / daemon instance
states.mutation_path: Written only by successful one-shot consume of enrollment authorization; survives Cloud/daemon restarts until key revoke.
states.lifecycle: Remains trusted across restarts until explicit key revoke; not established by HostedSession alone.
prohibited_fallbacks: Enroll from HostedSession or DaemonPairing alone
Treat /app session_token as enrollment evidence

states.artifact: Bounded cross-visit restore proof (request_handle, poll_proof, account, daemon URL, expires_at)
states.persistence_location: Browser durable restore record coordinated by Cloud; never contains session_token.
states.mutation_path: Written after successful pair handoff; cleared on sign-out, re-pair, expiry, revocation, or account mismatch.
states.lifecycle: Continuity witness for /restore while daemon policy still authorizes re-release; cannot extend daemon authority.
prohibited_fallbacks: Treat restore proof as /app success without live session_token
Store session_token inside the restore record
Use restore proof as enrollment authorization

states.artifact: Revoked, denied, expired, or binding-mismatched pairing outcome
states.persistence_location: Daemon decision/expiry records and durable store revocation marks.
states.mutation_path: Entered by deny, pending expiry, session/relationship revoke, or account/origin/daemon mismatch.
states.lifecycle: Terminal for the pending request or relationship; forces new code only when relationship is no longer valid.
prohibited_fallbacks: Silently reopen /app from Cloud session after terminal pairing
Remint session_token from a revoked pairing_id

transitions.trigger: Signed-in browser POSTs pending-first /pair from Cloud /connect with non-empty team_id and cloud_access_token.
transitions.persistence_effect: Creates short-TTL pending record in daemon memory with no session_token; retains team_id and request-scoped cloud_access_token for approve-time enroll.

transitions.trigger: Operator locally approves via CLI; daemon accepts LOCAL-only /pair/decision.
transitions.persistence_effect: Commits opaque durable pairing_id with bound account, team_id, origin, protocol/profile version, and TOFU daemon instance identity.

transitions.trigger: Same local approve mints ephemeral HostedBridgePairingSession / session_token.
transitions.persistence_effect: Writes live session into process memory only; not returned on the decision response.

transitions.trigger: Same local approve mints distinct short-TTL one-shot enrollment authorization.
transitions.persistence_effect: Creates unconsumed enrollment authorization bound to pairing_id and daemon instance identity.

transitions.trigger: Browser polls /pair/status after approve and receives live session_token into sessionStorage.
transitions.persistence_effect: Releases the same live token to sessionStorage; may also persist bounded restore proof without the token.

transitions.trigger: Bot /app accepts only a live daemon-minted session_token as paired-enough success witness.
transitions.persistence_effect: No new authority; /app consumes the live token and must not treat Cloud HostedSession as sufficient.

transitions.trigger: Browser cold start uses Cloud /restore with valid restore proof and daemon still authorizing re-release.
transitions.persistence_effect: Re-releases ephemeral session_token without a new pairing code when proof and daemon policy still match.

transitions.trigger: Daemon process restarts; durable pairing_id remains valid so daemon remints session_token without a new pairing code.
transitions.persistence_effect: Reads durable pairing_id relationship and creates a new ephemeral session in process memory.

transitions.trigger: Cloud enrollment consumer one-shot consumes the enrollment authorization and trusts the enrolled key.
transitions.persistence_effect: Marks authorization consumed; persists Cloud-trusted key until key revoke (row 12 consumer).

transitions.trigger: Operator denies, pending TTL expires, relationship is revoked, or binding mismatches.
transitions.persistence_effect: Terminalizes pending or durable relationship; subsequent /app or restore must fail closed without a new valid ceremony.

scenarios.name: First-time /connect pair to /app
scenarios.trigger: Signed-in operator opens Cloud /connect with no restorable relationship.
authority_boundaries: Pending-first never returns session_token.
Only LOCAL approve commits.
One ceremony yields session_token and enrollment authorization as separate artifacts.
POST /pair requires non-empty team_id and cloud_access_token before pending is created.
Missing/empty team_id or cloud_access_token returns HTTP 400 with typed kind; SPA maps to return-to-/connect.
cloud_access_token never persists, logs, or returns outside pending-record custody.
scenarios.expected_result: Browser reaches /app with a live daemon-minted session_token; durable pairing_id and unconsumed enrollment authorization exist; enrollment mint carries the pending team_id.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Deny, expiry, protocol mismatch, CSRF/origin failure, or missing team_id or cloud_access_token on POST /pair (typed 400, return-to-/connect) leaves the operator unpaired and shows no token.

scenarios.name: Browser cold start via /restore
scenarios.trigger: Tab lost sessionStorage token but bounded restore proof and daemon authorization remain valid.
authority_boundaries: Restore proof is not approval and not enrollment.
Cloud re-auth and account binding are required before status re-release.
scenarios.expected_result: Ephemeral session_token is re-released and /app resumes without a new pairing code.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Expired, revoked, malformed, or account-mismatched proof fails closed to /connect.

scenarios.name: Durable reattach after daemon process restart
scenarios.trigger: Daemon OS process is killed and restarted while the durable pairing_id relationship remains valid.
authority_boundaries: No new pairing code is required when pairing_id is non-revoked and bindings still match.
In-memory-only Alpha behavior is non-conformant for this freeze.
scenarios.expected_result: Daemon remints a new live session_token from durable pairing_id; /app can reattach without re-approve.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Missing durable store, revoke, or account/origin/daemon mismatch forces a fresh /connect code ceremony.

scenarios.name: Cloud or SPA cannot approve
scenarios.trigger: Remote browser or Cloud attempts POST /pair/decision or otherwise tries to approve.
authority_boundaries: Only missing/empty/loopback Origin may decide.
Code possession is not approval.
scenarios.expected_result: Decision is rejected; pending remains pending or expires without session_token.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Any accepted remote approve is a conformance failure.

scenarios.name: HostedSession must not enroll keys
scenarios.trigger: Cloud path attempts to treat HostedSession or DaemonPairing as enrollment authority.
authority_boundaries: Enrollment requires the distinct short-TTL one-shot authorization.
session_token / HostedSession open /app only.
scenarios.expected_result: Enrollment is refused without a valid unconsumed enrollment authorization.
scenarios.failure_behavior: cloud#303-class conflation is a cut-point invariant failure.

scenarios.name: Pairing hop is not Google OAuth/Drive
authority_boundaries: No shared authority objects, store, or pairing_id with row 5 OAuth/Drive.
Journey order pair-then-Drive is UX only.
scenarios.expected_result: Pairing artifacts remain independent of Google OAuth client config and Drive token continuity.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Any shared mint/store that manufactures Drive connected state from bridge session fails this scenario.

conformance.owner_module_or_seam: Cloud /connect + SPA Connect team resolution and bicameral-gateway POST /pair initiation validation (bot#1290)
conformance.required_behavior: Verified domain is Supabase-verified plus design-partner allowlist; consumer/shared domains are never allowlisted; team_id is a Cloud-issued opaque ID. Cloud resolves exactly one durable domain-scoped team (idempotent auto-create if zero eligible teams with TEAM_CREATED audit; distinct 409 with operator repair path if >1), and POSTs non-empty team_id plus cloud_access_token on /pair alongside origin/cloud_account_id/CSRF/protocol. Bot rejects missing/empty team_id or cloud_access_token with HTTP 400 typed kinds MissingTeamId / MissingCloudAccessToken; /connect and /app SPA map those to return-to-/connect. cloud_access_token is Alpha-appropriate as a raw Cloud access token; pending-record custody only; cleared on approve/deny/expiry; never persisted, logged, or returned. Any allowlisted-domain eligible user may create and enroll their own pairing; team_owner is not required. Design-partner domain allowlist is not team creation. Product selection remains out of the handshake. Client-supplied team_id is not enrollment trust alone; Cloud verifies bearer identity, allowlist, domain eligibility, and team_id/cloud_account_id binding at pairing create and enrollment.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Optional team_id or cloud_access_token on POST /pair with enroll-time fail-closed only; silent first-team pick; inventing a provisional team outside the Alpha auto-create rule; requiring Product selection before pair; requiring team_owner to create or enroll the caller's own pairing; persisting, logging, or returning cloud_access_token; treating a generic 4xx without typed kind as sufficient.

validation_obligation.description: Cloud Connect fixture resolves/creates sole domain team and includes team_id + cloud_access_token; Bot /pair returns 400 MissingTeamId or MissingCloudAccessToken without those fields; SPA maps those kinds to /connect; HTTP approve path carries pending team_id into PairingAuthorizationV1 mint.
